protocol.audio_insertion: bare: new frozen audio embeddings inside assistant continuation
protocol.positions: explicit monotonically increasing 3-axis positions, full causal attention
protocol.quality_scope: No training. Interleaved audio inside assistant continuation is out of the native turn layout.
protocol.timing_scope: Serialized source-arrival replay, not real-time microphone; no Talker or playback.
protocol.controls: natural EOS; EOS-suppressed diagnostic; matched-position silence; full exact-sequence replay
protocol.endpoint_scope: Known utterance end used for final embedding flush and final text drain
protocol.silence_scope: Silence is independently prefix-encoded with the same frozen commit policy, not zero embeddings.
